main_text.l: mus, ita & ab eadem nos non abhor- remus, sed potius ex animo optamus, ut Deus Opt. Max. dum orbis terra- rum passim odiis & furoribus ardet, miserè dilacerata Ecclesiæ Membra conglutinet, & in unius Corporis Harmoniam reducat, ac sublata omni diffidiorum inæqualitate, pacem & quietem Senescentis Ecclesiæ benignè concedat.

Ideoque licet penes Superiores Principes Convocationis instituendæ potestas sit, & ab illorum voluntate Executio legitima hujus Negotii dependeat, adeo ut non sit, quod de certiore ejusdem effectu quicquid polliceamur: tamen si Augustanæ Confessionis addicti Principes & Ordines, legitimi conventus instituendi rationes probaverint, nostramque hac in parte qualemcunque suffragationem requisiverint, certè in iisquæ ad constituendam pacem & tranquillitatem Christianæ Reip. pertinent, nostro loco, Regiæ Majestatis, omniumque piorum benigno desiderio & expectationi.

page.notes: Printed text is slightly blurred in places; the catchword "tioni" at the foot is read as the end of the last line. Words "Augustanæ" and "Ordines" are read with some doubt from the scan.
